claims.value: The franc CFA, then named franc des Colonies Françaises d’Afrique, was introduced in 1945.

scope.description: Named historical French equatorial administrative framework or expressly named Republic of Cameroon; no modern-border or successor-state inference.

evidence.locator: Historical chronology paragraph, web body lines 110–114; named AEF constituents and Cameroon emission area
evidence.note: Shared original body names Congo/Oubangui/Gabon/Chad and Cameroon before the CFA introduction. Only the year is submitted; 25/26 December distinction remains held. No assertion of CFA before late December1945.

evidence.locator: La Zone franc avant les indépendances, 1945 entry (web body line 19)
evidence.note: Independent government history confirms the same1945 creation year but gives26December. Candidate retains shared year only.

qualifications: This is the actual1945 monetary-system introduction event in the expressly named AEF/Cameroon emission area; yearprecision does not make the unit available at a January1945 snapshot.
BEAC body gives25December1945; its overview and French Treasury give26December1945. Exact day withheld; no claim of unchanged pre1945 unit.

claims.value: Franco-African monetary cooperation through the Banque Centrale des Etats de l’Afrique Equatoriale et du Cameroun (BCEAEC)

scope.description: Named historical French equatorial administrative framework or expressly named Republic of Cameroon; no modern-border or successor-state inference.

evidence.locator: Printed page 14 / PDF page index13, Chapter1 section1 (lines 300–306)
evidence.note: Historical body explicitly describes BCEAEC as arising from cooperation accords concluded between the French Republic and five named states including the Republic of Cameroon. Dated association kept to1960, not inferred from current membership.

qualifications: Association is expressly monetary cooperation with France in the BCEAEC historical system; not colonial sovereignty, political control, nationality, modern CEMAC membership or modern BEAC role. Yearprecision remains partial.
